spec.description: Setup for case B of llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-pr-capability-composition-fast-follow.md, no claims. In the setup worktrees under ~/.cache/in-the-loop/organic-composition-ff/worktrees (B-poi-fix = bd15f5bc, B-poi-parent = 6b277ffc), builds :poi:jar with the upstream Gradle 9.8.1 wrapper on JDK 17.0.21 (toolchain 17, auto-download off), --offline: the setup session resolved every :poi configuration online first into the cache's gradle-home. Runs each side's own TestDataFormatter, then the landed file transplanted onto the parent, where the new tests are expected to fail (the transplant is restored after). Jars to .../artifacts with sha256, JUnit summaries to .../logs, build trees removed. Results go into llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-pr-capability-composition-fast-follow-setup.md.
